title: DOW-UAP-PR052, "UAP USO Formation [CALLSIGN] (Mission)"
what_is_it: A video file from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform, uploaded to a classified network, showing unidentified areas of contrast in formation.
interpretation_warnings: The video was digitally altered prior to upload — the nature and extent of alteration is not specified.
Many materials in this collection lack a substantiated chain-of-custody, undermining provenance confidence.
The callsign in the title is redacted, preventing identification of the originating unit or mission.
The video description in the CSV metadata is truncated, so the full timeline of events is incomplete.
The auto-transcribed audio contains only repeated instances of the word 'You', providing no substantive information.
AARO uses hedging language ('likely derived from'), indicating the sensor source is not confirmed.
The uploader-defined title references 'USO' (Unidentified Submerged Object) but no water or submersion is described in the available portion of the video description.
